purpose: Three-turn cross-sector journey from terse questions to a durable local dashboard.

tasks.gold_sql: SELECT block, ROUND(1.0 * harvest_tonnes / cultivated_hectares, 1) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year = 2024 ORDER BY tonnes_per_hectare DESC, block
phrasings: make a 2024 Monsoon block wise crop yield dashboard, tonnes per hectare highest first

tasks.pattern: follow-up expands the durable result to a time trend
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT block, year, ROUND(1.0 * harvest_tonnes / cultivated_hectares, 1) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year IN (2023, 2024) ORDER BY block, year
phrasings: now show 2023 and 2024 Monsoon tonnes per hectare trend for every block

tasks.pattern: follow-up narrows entities and computes a time difference
tasks.gold_sql: WITH yields AS (SELECT block, year, 1.0 * harvest_tonnes / cultivated_hectares AS yield_value FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND block IN ('Bhojpur', 'Wardha') AND year IN (2023, 2024)) SELECT block, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN yield_value END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN yield_value END), 1) AS change_tonnes_per_hectare FROM yields GROUP BY block ORDER BY block
phrasings: only Bhojpur and Wardha now, compare change in tonnes per hectare from 2023 to 2024
